## Ready to publish

The complete document can be published faithfully to mike-north/doc-linter#64 at commit `5ebfe7da336d6e1ad6de8b5a04f73924de5d0a5b`.

Publication would also create 1 draft suggestion pull request into `exp-reapply-20260929-rewritten`, labeled `suggestion-pr`. The history of #64 was rewritten after the reviewed commit, so it is re-applied onto commit `080ce5eb7dfa54049e44510f51fe41b83abb4ae3`, where everything it changes is still exactly as reviewed.

**Review prepared:** 0 inline comment(s) and 4 general section(s) for commit `5ebfe7da336d6e1ad6de8b5a04f73924de5d0a5b`.

**Warnings:**

- `suggestion-pr-not-reapplied` at `/runs/0/results/0`: The history of #64 was rewritten after the reviewed commit, so the suggestion pull request `Suggestion for #64: reword (2 changes)` would have to be re-applied onto commit `080ce5eb7dfa54049e44510f51fe41b83abb4ae3`, and it cannot be: `docs/experiments/reapply/sample-rewritten.md` line 6 differs from the reviewed text. It is not created; its change and findings are presented in the review body.
- `suggestion-pr-not-reapplied` at `/runs/0/results/3`: The history of #64 was rewritten after the reviewed commit, so the suggestion pull request `Suggestion for #64: delete docs/experiments/reapply/obsolete-rewritten.txt` would have to be re-applied onto commit `080ce5eb7dfa54049e44510f51fe41b83abb4ae3`, and it cannot be: `docs/experiments/reapply/obsolete-rewritten.txt` differs from the reviewed file. It is not created; its change and findings are presented in the review body.

Nothing was published and no publication state was written.

This is not an approval: publication repeats every check against the pull request as it is then. GitHub can still refuse the review, for example when this account already has a pending review on the pull request.
